title: marrubium flavum
intro: Marrubium flavum, commonly known as yellow marrubium or lemon marrubium, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and ease respiratory problems due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Marrubium flavum include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and diuretic properties, which help alleviate symptoms of cough, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Marrubium flavum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
